title: Factorization of the two explicit raw pullbacks
statement: For Λ commutative, k:W→S, G a module sheaf, q a natural degree, U etale over S, A,B over W and f:A→B, the module raw pullback of z equals moduleSourceFactor followed by derived inverse image of z followed by moduleCoefficientFactor. Independently, for every abelian raw class x on B, its abelian raw pullback equals abelianSourceFactor followed by derived inverse image of x followed by abelianCoefficientFactor. No relation between z and x is assumed. Interpret the raw class values occurring in this equation at their native derived Hom types using the concrete identity views [def-sbc-raw-class-native-morphisms]; the elements and equality are unchanged. Write the module coefficient morphism at its named raw-complex endpoints using the definitionally equal canonical view [def-sbc-module-coefficient-native-endpoints]. The abelian coefficient sheaf is the pullback of the forgotten sheaf from W [lem-sbc-restricted-over-abelian-complex-data].

proof.text: Use rawModuleClassMorphism_heq and higherDirectImageRawOverPullbackHom_apply to evaluate the bundled raw functor map as its prescribed raw pullback. Extract the two factors defining moduleSourceFactor and apply symmetric Category.assoc to them and the remaining derived-map/coefficient tail. Checked HEq congruences identify the expanded raw pullback and the displayed factors, using the native-class computation rule, the concrete native coefficient view and the existing raw-complex endpoint equations. Normalize local abbreviations and equivalent universe expressions; memoize congruence proofs and use Lean proof constructors directly, avoiding repeated elaborator unification of already constructed proofs. No scalar-comparison coherence is used.
Apply rawModuleScalar_pullback_abelian_formula to the independent arbitrary abelian class and combine the two identities by conjunction.

theorem rawModuleScalar_pullback_formulas
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)) :
    (rawModuleClassMorphism Λ k G (q : ℤ) U A
      ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z) =
      moduleSourceFactor Λ f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (Over.w_assoc f k) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (rawModuleClassMorphism Λ k G (q : ℤ) U B z) ≫
        moduleCoefficientFactorNative Λ G (q : ℤ) A B f) ∧
    (∀ (x : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf (B.hom ≫ k) q
      (restrictedOverCoefficient ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) B)).obj
        (op U)),
      rawAbelianClassMorphism (A.hom ≫ k)
        (restrictedOverCoefficient ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) A) q U
        (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (Over.w_assoc f k) q _ _
        ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left B.hom A.hom
          (Over.w f).symm).inv.app ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G)) U x) =
      abelianSourceFactor f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (Over.w_assoc f k) (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (rawAbelianClassMorphism (B.hom ≫ k)
          (restrictedOverCoefficient ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) B) q U x) ≫
      abelianCoefficientFactor ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G)
        (q : ℤ) A B f)

A proved private categorical identity factors rawTriangleMap, after whiskering its source comparison by freeSheaf, as rawTriangleSource followed by the derived image of z and the coefficient map.
